candidates: When reviewing `package.json` changes, verify that no deprecated packages have been introduced — including ones that appear to have been auto-added or re-sorted by the package manager (e.g., pnpm) rather than explicitly by the author — and remove any packages flagged as deprecated.

In development demo files (e.g., under `demos/`) and client-side event-driven code (EventSource, WebSocket, etc.), ensure error event handlers explicitly log the error to the console rather than silently ignoring it, so failures are visible during development.

In TypeScript tooling files (e.g., under `.esbuild/`), add explicit type annotations to non-trivial local variables unless their type is already fully and unambiguously constrained by a strongly-typed API; do not rely on implicit inference when the variable's shape is not immediately obvious.

When configuring file-watcher ignore patterns (e.g., chokidar's `ignored` option), verify that patterns intended to exclude directories like `node_modules` match at all nesting levels (e.g., use `**/node_modules/**` glob syntax), not only at the root of the watched tree.
